nom: Paula's Choice Resist Anti-Aging Eye Cream

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and eyelid eczema!!!!
avis.texte: I was hesitant to purchase because of the other reviews, but I'm so glad I did. I have very sensitive skin/eczema, especially around my eyes. Eyelid eczema is no joke, it's painful and miserable, and a lot of anti-aging products make it worse, especially eye creams because sooo many of them have fragrance. Not this one! No irritation, at all, and my eyelid eczema has completely cleared up. I will never be without this now. I can see how people with oily skin wouldn't like this product since it is a very thick cream. Despite being so thick it has always absorbed very quickly for me. For dry and sensitive skin, I say go for it. I purchased the sample size to see how I liked it before purchasing the full size. The sample size will actually last quite a while, (at least a month, maybe two) a little goes a long ways.

I had high hopes for this product after reading a rave review on Paula's Choice website. In winter, my skin is extremely dry and my undereye area especially can use some extra help. Unfortunately, this cream comes from the tube in big clumps that are impossible to spread on my skin. I tried warming up the product in my hands before applying it, to no avail. I end up dragging the lumps of cream under my eyes and applying too much pressure, which is exactly what I'd like to avoid. It's like spreading cold butter on a piece of bread! Perhaps I just got an old tube, but I think I will be returning this. Very disappointing...

avis.titre: Great for skin around eyes but also for eyes
avis.texte: I have used this for years before bedtime and it's completely solved dry eyes as well as being a lovely PM eye product. It IS quite a thick cream as others have commented, but three seconds of rubbing between fingers, and it spreads and is absorbed easily. I have older, dry skin and live in a dry environment half the year and it's really been perfect. I also have extremely sensitive skin and no irritation whatsoever. I'm not sure it's worth the $ compared to a drug store brand but the eye comfort along is worth the price.

Did nothing for me. Idk why she's selling eye cream when she herself stated that eye cream is irrelevant. Didn't realize this until after I'd bought the product. Honestly thought it made my eyes a little worse. I just use a completely natural oil, one ingredient product from Limelife by alcone called One drop wonder. Research it. Truly moisturizes my eyes like crazy. It burns if it gets in the eyes though so be warned. Says not to use it around eyes on the box) but I do it anyway because it's the only thing I've found to make a difference.

As other's have mentioned, this is a thick cream. That being said, I have no problem patting it under my eyes as directed and it absorbing. I have hereditary dark circles and have not noticed a difference in them, but there is really no product that will make those disappear. My under eye area is smother appearing and my crows feet appear softer now due to being moisturized. I only use this at night as I have found it to be too emollient for use during the day and it does not play well under makeup resulting in concealer sliding off.

Very thick but easy to apply by warming up between fingers and tapping instead of rubbing. Great for dry skin around the eye. Based on other reviews, I use with Boost oil which is also great. Better results than many other products including much more expensive eye treatments from Estee Lauder. If you live in a dry environment, give it a try. I'm more than two months into the first tube and there is still plenty. Update: I've had two other tubes, the formula seems creamier. Also a hint : cut open the tube when it's done and you'll find more cream.

avis.titre: A really good eye cream that goes the distance
avis.texte: A nice thick eye cream that hydrates. Not sure that it does much for eye lines but an eye cream can only do so much. A tiny bit warmed between my fingers and patted onto my eyes works for me and a tube lasts a good while so makes the price easier to take. I’m ahem mature so I love how moisturizing this is.

Only thing that works around my eyes during severe eczema flare ups, when not even the most gentle doctor-recommended eczema creams will work! Caused me no burning and soothed/ moisturized my delicate eyelid skin. This is expensive but so worth it to me!

avis.titre: Product does not contain Sun Protection Factor (SPF)
avis.texte: I was very surprised that this is an "anti-aging" product with no SPF. The instructions on the tube literally state to follow with SPF 25 or greater. Competing products in this price range already contain the SPF (i.e. Supergoop! Advanced Anti-Aging Eye Cream with Oat Peptide SPF 37, 0.5 fl. oz.). It felt like applying any other thick, white shea butter product. I think it would be more accurate to label this as a "moisturizing" eye cream rather than "anti-aging" eye cream. I received a promotional sample of this product.
